description.value: Sushi Mura is a Japanese sushi chain that has operated in Vancouver since 2012, with the Main Street location one of several across the Lower Mainland. The restaurant emphasises daily-delivered fresh fish and a broad menu spanning rolls, sashimi, nigiri, noodle bowls, and hot appetisers. Dine-in, takeout, and third-party delivery are all offered, making it a convenient stop on a busy urban cycling corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is Branch 04 (Main St) of the Sushi Mura chain at 3068 Main St, Vancouver, BC V5T 3G5, with phone 604-428-5700 listed on the contact and about pages. The site explicitly states takeout is available for pick-up and via UberEats, Skip The Dish, and DoorDash. No evidence of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the website or in OSM tags; the menu does include several vegetarian-friendly items (seaweed salad, agedashi tofu, vegetable sunomono).
